result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_mean_distance()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get mean distance (average shortest path length). ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L16871-L16923){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_mean_distance(unconnected=True) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Computes average shortest path length between all reachable node pairs. Also known as average path length or characteristic path length. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [unconnected]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[True]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, computes weighted average across all connected components. If `False`, returns `None` for disconnected graphs. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Average shortest path length, or `None` if graph is disconnected (when `unconnected=False`). ::: ## Technical Notes {.doc-technical-notes} Important network metric: - small-world networks: low mean distance despite high clustering - scale-free networks: mean distance grows logarithmically with size - used in epidemiology: average infection spread time ## Examples {.doc-examples} Calculate mean distance in a path graph: ::: {#94127cd1 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_node(label="D") .add_edge("A", "B") .add_edge("B", "C") .add_edge("C", "D") ) mean_dist = graph.get_mean_distance() # Paths: A-B(1), A-C(2), A-D(3), B-C(1), B-D(2), C-D(1) # Returns approximately 1.67 (average: (1+2+3+1+2+1)/6) mean_dist ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 1.6666666666666665 ``` ::: :::
